fields.statement: QA with a scratch build of ./cmd/rhiza (fake rex/claude, scratch root): a run whose session spawned a fixer that went idle with no done mark; rhiza daemon --once at 00:19 did nothing, at 00:21 nudged the fixer only (not the conductor), at 00:41 closed both sessions' panes, stopped the run and queued one --retry continue (spent 1 of 2), which the next poll resumed. A fixer re-reporting at 00:40 kept the 50-minute-silent conductor from being nudged or stopped; a fixer that said done (spawn-ended) was never nudged or counted. Scoped go test (TestWatchdogStalled|TestDaemonNudgeStalled|TestStepSessions|TestRunStalled) passes.

QA with a scratch build of ./cmd/rhiza: the watchdog's stall retry of a spawned fixer appended one warning entry naming the fixer's session, role fixer, its parent session and its last report time; the charged attempt and the bug request name the same; rhiza run status --json lists it. With retryBudget 0 the hold detail and the rhiza inbox --json stalled item name the session and role. The nudge-only poll journalled no warning; a plain step session was named as the step's session with no parent. Minor: human rhiza run status text prints no warnings. Scoped go test TestWatchdogStalled passes.
